PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Senior Functional Business Analyst with 12+ years of experience delivering business and 
regulatory transformation initiatives across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Asset 
Management, and Financial Services. Experienced in collaborating with business and technology 
stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, prepare functional 
documentation, and support end-to-end solution delivery across Agile and Waterfall 
environments. 
Strong functional expertise in Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives, Corporate Actions, 
Reference Data, Fund Accounting, NAV, Trade Lifecycle, Data Governance, and Regulatory 
Reporting. Proven ability to bridge business and technology teams by translating business needs 
into functional requirements, supporting solution design, coordinating UAT, and driving 
successful implementation of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. 
Experienced working with global stakeholders across EMEA, APAC, and North America, 
supporting strategic change initiatives through business analysis, process improvement, data 
governance, and functional testing.
